Handmade with care, this ceramic mug is made to be part of your daily routine. Each piece is one of a kind, so small variations in the finish are part of its charm. Whether it holds your morning coffee, an afternoon tea, or a cozy evening cocoa, it's a mug you'll want to reach for again and again.

Cleanup is easy: it's dishwasher safe. Please note that it is not microwave safe, so heat your drink another way and pour it in. It also makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who appreciates handmade pieces.
